name:

HORIZON LEGACY + - Update
formal_name:
ACE COMBAT™ ASSAULT
HORIZON LEGACY + - Update
description:
This patch enables compatibility with
the Nintendo 3DS™ NFC reader/writer.
Now with any Nintendo 3DS™ model,
you will be able to unlock exclusive
aircrafts inspired by corresponding
amiibo™ figurine.
disclaimer:
You may need to upgrade your current SD Card to a compatible SDHC Card or microSDHC Card with enough available space to download this software.
Visit support.nintendo.com for information about storage options. Sold separately.
